description:
Unified ATS analytics. Select report type:
- "dashboard" — Hiring health report: key metrics, stage distribution, offer stats, velocity, insights
- "pipeline"  — Funnel analysis: conversion rates, avg days-in-stage, bottleneck detection
- "full"      — Both reports combined

candidates.description: Array of candidate objects. Required for 'pipeline' report. For 'full'/'dashboard', candidates come from state.

jobId.description: Optional: filter pipeline analytics to a specific job.

report_type.description: Which report to generate. Defaults to "full".

stageOrder.description: Ordered pipeline stages for funnel analysis. Defaults to: ["applied","screening","phone-screen","interview","final-round","offer","hired","rejected"]

state.description: ATS state object with candidates, jobs, interviews, and offers records (each keyed by ID). Required for 'dashboard' and 'full' reports.

name: ats_analytics
